about: What is laid is read again from its bytes by the method that named the release, and the pass lands the digest as a receipt, laid/<name>/digest, keyed by the stamps of the bytes it read. The reading counts each release whose bytes as they lie now have no receipt, or one whose digest is not the one the lock names.
